Package ir.mehran1022.api

Class PottySnake

java.lang.Object
ir.mehran1022.api.PottySnake
public final class PottySnake extends Object
A robust library for managing YAML files utilizing the SnakeYAML library. This class provides methods to load, save, and manipulate YAML data with ease.

    • PottySnake

      public PottySnake(String filePath) throws IOException
      Constructs a new PottySnake instance associated with the given file path. It initializes the parser and loads the existing YAML content into memory.
      Parameters:
      filePath - The path to the YAML file to manage.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the file cannot be read or written to.

    • PottySnake

      public PottySnake(String filePath, org.yaml.snakeyaml.DumperOptions options) throws IOException
      Constructs a new PottySnake instance with custom DumperOptions.
      Parameters:
      filePath - The path to the YAML file to manage.
      options - Custom DumperOptions for YAML formatting.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the file cannot be read or written to.

    • setDumperOptions

      public void setDumperOptions(org.yaml.snakeyaml.DumperOptions options)
      Sets custom DumperOptions for subsequent saves.
      Parameters:

    • load

      public void load() throws IOException
      Loads the YAML content from the file into the data map. If the file does not exist, an empty file is created. If the file is empty or contains invalid YAML, an empty map is initialized.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the file cannot be read.

    • reload

      public void reload() throws IOException
      Reloads the YAML content from the file, discarding any in-memory changes. Throws if the file does not exist.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the file cannot be read or does not exist.

    • save

      public void save() throws IOException
      Saves the in-memory data map to the YAML file. The data is converted to a YAML-formatted string and written to the file.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the file cannot be written to.

    • getEntry

      public Object getEntry(String key)
      Retrieves a value from the YAML data using a dot-notation key. Example: getEntry("database.host") returns the "host" inside "database".
      Parameters:
      key - The key to retrieve the value for (nullable/empty not allowed).
      Returns:
      The value, or null if the key does not exist.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if key is null or empty.

    • addEntry

      public void addEntry(String section, String key, Object value) throws IOException
      Adds an entry to the specified section. - If the section is a map, the key-value pair is added (key must not be null). - If the section is a list, the value is appended (key must be null). - If the section does not exist, a map is created (if key non-null) or a list (if key null).
      Parameters:
      section - The section key (root-level only, not nested).
      key - The key for the entry within the section, or null if adding to a list.
      value - The value to add.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.
      IllegalArgumentException - If section is null/empty or key usage mismatches type.

    • setEntry

      public void setEntry(String key, Object value) throws IOException
      Adds or updates an entry in the YAML data using a dot-notation key. Intermediate maps are created as needed; will throw if an intermediate path is not a map.
      Parameters:
      key - Dot-notation key.
      value - Value to set.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.
      IllegalStateException - If an intermediate path is not a map.

    • removeEntry

      public void removeEntry(String key) throws IOException
      Removes an entry from the YAML data using a dot-notation key. Silently does nothing if the key does not exist or an intermediate path is missing.
      Parameters:
      key - Dot-notation key.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.

    • createSection

      public void createSection(String section) throws IOException
      Ensures a dot-notation path exists as a map. Creates nested maps as needed. If the leaf already exists and is a map, no change. If leaf exists as non-map, overwrites with empty map.
      Parameters:
      section - Dot-notation path.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.

    • hasSection

      public boolean hasSection(String section)
      Checks if a section exists (any non-null value) at the given dot-notation path.
      Parameters:
      section - Dot-notation path.
      Returns:
      true if the path exists and has a non-null value.

    • renameSection

      public void renameSection(String oldSection, String newSection) throws IOException
      Renames a section: moves the value from oldSection to newSection. Only works if oldSection exists; does nothing otherwise.
      Parameters:
      oldSection - Existing dot-notation path.
      newSection - New dot-notation path.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.

    • createList

      public void createList(String section) throws IOException
      Ensures a dot-notation path exists as a list. Creates nested maps as needed. If the leaf already exists and is a list, no change. If leaf exists as non-list, overwrites with empty list.
      Parameters:
      section - Dot-notation path.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.

    • setEntries

      public void setEntries(Map<String,Object> entries) throws IOException
      Replaces the entire data with the given entries and saves.
      Parameters:
      entries - Map of entries to set (clears existing data first). If null, does nothing.
      Throws:
      IOException - If save fails.

    • addEntries

      public void addEntries(Map<String,Object> entries) throws IOException

      Throws:
